title: IMPERATOR: The Burden of the Danube

scenarios.name: The Gathering Storm
scenarios.rule: The first Petition each game costs no Treasury.
scenarios.history: Pressure builds while disease and the eastern war limit Rome's freedom of action.

scenarios.name: Italy Invaded
scenarios.rule: If Quadi Threat reaches 6, lose 2 Rome instead of losing immediately; lose if it remains 6 at round end.
scenarios.history: A coalition breaks through the frontier and threatens Aquileia in northern Italy.

scenarios.name: Beyond the Danube
scenarios.rule: Campaigns in Marcomannia gain +1 Roman total, but every Exertion there costs 1 Resolve.
scenarios.history: Marcus carries the war north, seeking leverage against the Marcomanni.

scenarios.name: Among the Quadi
scenarios.rule: Once per game after losing a battle, set both dice to 4; then lose 1 Treasury. This represents the contested rain-miracle tradition without choosing an explanation.
scenarios.history: The Quadi campaign combines hard fighting, disputed kingship, thirst, weather, and propaganda.

scenarios.name: The Sarmatian Plain
scenarios.rule: The Enemy die gains +1 on the Plain of the Iazyges unless at least three Legions are committed.
scenarios.history: Roman forces confront the mobile Iazyges and seek prisoners, auxiliaries, and a durable settlement.

scenarios.name: The Eastern Usurper
scenarios.rule: Each Campaign costs 1 Treasury. The first time Senate reaches 5, gain 2 Momentum.
scenarios.history: Avidius Cassius is proclaimed emperor in the east, forcing Marcus to balance speed, legitimacy, and clemency.

scenarios.name: The Second Expedition
scenarios.rule: At the end of rounds 4 and 7, lose 1 Resolve unless you Meditated that round.
scenarios.history: War resumes. Marcus pursues an unfinished northern settlement while age, fatigue, and succession narrow his time.

scenarios.name: The Burden of the Danube
scenarios.rule: After rounds 3 and 6, reduce Fatigue by 1 but increase the highest Threat by 1. At round 8, lose 1 Resolve.
scenarios.history: A compressed full reign: epidemic, invasion, counteroffensive, revolt, renewed war, and the question of what peace will survive.

commands.name: Redeploy the Vexillations
commands.imperium: March, then March again with one of the moved Legions.
commands.officium: Gain 1 Senate; then move one Legion one connection toward Aquileia.

commands.name: Secure the River
commands.imperium: Pay 1 Supply: reduce Threat by 1 at two fronts connected to bases containing Legions.

commands.name: Pompeianus Commands
commands.imperium: Campaign with +2 Roman total. Marcus cannot use Assent in that battle.
commands.officium: Gain 1 Senate and reduce Fatigue by 1.

commands.name: Raise New Legions
commands.imperium: Pay 3 Treasury: return one lost Legion to Aquileia.
commands.officium: Pay 2 Treasury and 1 Senate: return one lost Legion to Aquileia and gain 1 Rome.

commands.name: Fortify Italy and the Alps
commands.imperium: Reduce Threat by 2 on the Raetian Frontier or in Marcomannia; pay 1 Supply.

commands.name: Divide the Coalition
commands.imperium: Choose two adjacent Threats. Reduce one by 2 and increase the other by 1.
commands.officium: Spend 1 Senate: reduce any Threat by 1 and gain 1 Mercy.

commands.name: Forced March
commands.imperium: Move up to three Legions through one extra connection; increase Fatigue by 1.

commands.name: Winter Quarters
commands.imperium: Reduce Fatigue by 2. You may Fortify once.
commands.officium: Gain 1 Resolve, 1 Supply, and 1 Senate; increase the highest Threat by 1.

commands.name: Address the Troops
commands.imperium: Campaign. On a tie or loss, gain 1 Resolve after consequences.
commands.officium: Gain 2 Resolve; lose 1 Senate unless Mercy is 3+.

commands.name: Take Hostages
commands.imperium: After winning a battle, reduce Threat by 1 more; lose 1 Mercy.
commands.officium: Gain 2 Senate if total Threat is 8 or less; otherwise gain 1 Treasury.

commands.name: Return the Prisoners
commands.imperium: Spend 1 Momentum: reduce a Threat at 2 or less to 0 and gain 2 Mercy.
commands.officium: Gain 1 Rome and 1 Mercy; lose 1 Treasury.

commands.name: Danube Fleet
commands.imperium: Move any number of Legions between Carnuntum and Sirmium, then gain +1 in a battle at Quadi or Iazyges.

commands.name: Council at Carnuntum
commands.imperium: Look at the next two Crises. Return them in either order, then Fortify.
commands.officium: Look at the next three Crises. Put one on the bottom.

commands.name: No More Than Duty
commands.imperium: Campaign without increasing Fatigue this round.
commands.officium: Meditate, then Petition without paying Treasury.

commands.name: Clemency After Victory
commands.imperium: Campaign. If you win, gain Mercy instead of Momentum and reduce Fatigue by 1.
commands.officium: Spend 1 Senate: gain 1 Mercy, 1 Rome, and 1 Resolve.

crises.name: Langobardi Cross the River
crises.design: If no Legion is at Carnuntum or Quadi, increase it by 1 again.

crises.name: Eleven Envoys
crises.arrival: Choose: spend 1 Senate to reduce the highest Threat by 1, or gain 1 Treasury and increase it by 1.
crises.design: If two Threats are tied for highest, both press this round.

crises.name: The Plague Returns
crises.arrival: Lose 1 Rome or remove one Legion to the lost box.

crises.name: Lucius Is Dead
crises.arrival: Lose 1 Resolve. Choose a space; Legions there cannot March this round.
crises.design: Gain 1 Senate if you used Officium.

crises.name: The Road to Aquileia
crises.arrival: Increase Marcomannia and Quadi Threat by 1.
crises.design: If their combined Threat is 8+, lose 1 Rome.

crises.name: Opitergium Burned
crises.arrival: Lose 1 Rome. Requisition gains 3 Supply this round.
crises.design: If you did not Campaign or Fortify, lose 1 Senate.

crises.name: Ballomar's Coalition
crises.design: Reduce a different Threat by 1 if you used diplomacy this round.

crises.name: The Costoboci Raid South
crises.arrival: Pay 2 Treasury or lose 1 Rome and 1 Senate.
crises.design: Iazyges presses regardless of its Threat.

crises.name: Across the Frozen Danube
crises.arrival: Campaigns at Quadi or Iazyges gain +1 this round; each Roman loss also costs 1 Supply.
crises.design: Increase Fatigue by 1 if you fought.

crises.name: The Rain and the Thirst
crises.design: If you used Assent, reduce the battled settlement's Threat by 1.

crises.name: Ariogaesus Defies Rome
crises.arrival: Increase Quadi Threat by 2 unless you spend 1 Senate.
crises.design: If Quadi is at 1 or less, gain 1 Momentum.

crises.name: Horsemen of the Iazyges
crises.arrival: Move one Legion out of Iazyges or increase its Threat by 2.
crises.design: The Enemy die gains +1 at Iazyges this round.

crises.name: One Hundred Thousand Captives
crises.arrival: Choose: gain 2 Rome, or gain 1 Mercy and reduce Iazyges Threat by 1.
crises.design: Lose 1 Supply if Iazyges is not pacified.

crises.name: Cassius Takes the Purple
crises.arrival: Lose 2 Senate. You may spend 2 Treasury to lose only 1.
crises.design: If Senate is 2 or less, lose 1 Rome.

crises.name: Commodus at the Front
crises.arrival: Gain 1 Rome or 1 Senate. Then lose 1 Resolve unless Mercy is 3+.
crises.design: If you Campaign, gain +1 Roman total and increase Fatigue by 1.

crises.name: Time Is a River
crises.arrival: Choose: lose 1 Resolve, or increase two Threats by 1.
crises.design: If this is the final round, gain 1 VP for each pacified settlement.
